about_the_game:
Congratulations!

You have been hired as a staff member in charge of this operation.

During the five days, please do not miss typing specific sentences and checking the surveillance cameras.

【Notice of Employment】

  • Duration: 5 days

  • Working hours: 0:00 AM to 6:00 AM

  • Duties: Typing specific sentences and monitoring rooms

  • Salary: Paid at the end of the workday

※We are not responsible for any damage caused by this work.

【Game Description】

"Monativity Surveillance” is a game in which you have to enter specific sentences and report anomalies that appear in the surveillance camera images.

There are two main things to do in the game

Type in the sentences displayed on the computer screen.

Switching between multiple surveillance cameras and reporting any anomalies that appear.

The work hours will be from midnight to 6:00 a.m., and you will be required to do this for five days.

(There is some slight horror in this game. If this is not your cup of tea, please beware)

【Playing time】

About 30 to 60 minutes.

If you want to collect all endings, it will take about 2  to 3 hour.

【Operation Methods】

WS key, arrow keys (up/down): Move to surveillance camera and computer screen

AD key, arrow keys (left/right): Switch camera images when viewing surveillance cameras

Click: Reporting anomalies, etc.

Esc key: Show/hide the menu screen

Operation instructions are also provided in the game.

【Rules for Live Streaming and Distribution】

  • Anyone is welcome to play and stream the game (no permission is required).

  • Monetization through distribution is also acceptable for both corporations and individuals.

  • We would appreciate it if you include the name of the game in the title of the video or streaming video, and a link to the Steam store page in the summary section.

  • Posting or live distribution of content that is offensive to public order and morals or that significantly damages the value of the game is prohibited.

  • We will not be held responsible for any damages incurred by the publisher or any third party as a result of posting or live distribution of videos.

  • The above terms and conditions are subject to change without notice.
